summary: Willamette NF lookout site near Oakridge: L-5 emergency cab of 1933, replaced by an L-4 cab in 1954, disposed of by burning in 1968; no source describes the site today.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register says removed in 1968, firelookout.com says destroyed in 1968, and Oregon Lookouts says disposed of by burning on August 27, 1968. They agree on the year; only Oregon Lookouts gives the method.
Register, firelookout.com and Oregon Lookouts all give 1933 for the L-5 cab. The 1932 newspaper items show the lookouts were planned the year before, which the story notes.

notes_for_editor: The history is well covered: three sources agree on the 1933 and 1954 cabs and on the 1968 removal, and the Oregon Lookouts page reprints 1932 and 1948 newspaper items. Nothing in these sources says what remains on the site or whether it is open to visitors, so the story says so. The brief's L-5 design is correct but leaves out the 1954 L-4 replacement, which is now in the facts. The Oregon Lookouts page calls the 1933 house an Aladdin emergency house; the maker is not named in the story. Oregon Lookouts gives the 1971 letter's recipient as the Oakridge district ranger, which is kept as written.
